modes.description: Named bootstrap for rapid localhost or emulator UI iteration with minimal patches and affected-screen validation by default.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Target repo id, repo path, or repo-path basename resolved against the stack repo inventory.

startup_rules: assume localhost or emulator is already running unless stated otherwise
accept one small scoped change at a time
make the minimal patch
prefer affected-screen validation by default
reserve broader screenshot sweeps for checkpoints
escalate when the request stops being rapid-loop sized

template: request: send the first small change

modes.description: Named bootstrap for broader checkpoint validation after one or more rapid-loop edits, starting with related-flow coverage and widening only when justified.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Target repo id, repo path, or repo-path basename resolved against the stack repo inventory.

startup_rules: assume localhost or emulator is still available unless stated otherwise
treat the task as a checkpoint validation pass rather than a micro-change loop
start from the smallest sweep that answers the checkpoint question
prefer Level 2 related-flow sweep first
use Level 3 full-app sweep only when the checkpoint or operator request warrants it
report what was checked, what still needs eyes, and whether the checkpoint is satisfied

template: request: tell me the changed area or the checkpoint you want covered

modes.description: Named bootstrap for work that has grown beyond rapid-loop size and now needs explicit scope, shared-surface reasoning, and broader validation posture.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Target repo id, repo path, or repo-path basename resolved against the stack repo inventory.

startup_rules: stop treating the task as a rapid-loop change
identify the structural seam before editing
clarify the likely blast radius across routes, components, schemas, shared chrome, or data contracts
prefer a bounded implementation plan before patching
choose validation based on the breadth of the change rather than affected-screen defaults
call out when checkpoint or full-app sweeps are now justified

template: suspected scope: <shared surface or contract area>
request: tell me the structural target or the constraint to preserve

modes.description: Named bootstrap for review-first work where findings, regression risk, and verification gaps should be reported before implementation.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Target repo id, repo path, or repo-path basename resolved against the stack repo inventory.

startup_rules: treat the task as review-first rather than implementation-first
prioritize bugs, regressions, risky assumptions, and missing tests
report findings before summaries or change overviews
keep findings concrete and tied to files, screens, routes, or contracts when possible
call out residual risk even when no findings are found
propose follow-on validation only after the findings section is clear

template: scope assumption: repo or diff review
request: tell me the review target, branch, or diff surface
